name: Midori Fumi
source:
Fumi works with [url=/c98386]Hiyono[/url] on the school newspaper and spends a lot of her time running around the school trying to get info to put in the paper. She has found her raison d'etre in obtaining information and releasing it faster than anyone else. Although she treats the clumsy Hiyono sternly, she's fond of her.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
